steps.hardClue: Activate the ancient artifact, then reveal three visions inside hidden crystals.
steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact, then reveal the three crystal visions.

steps.hardClue: Complete the three challenges revealed by the crystal visions.
steps.clue: Complete the clock, Perk Statue and ghost challenges to collect the three Tuning Forks.

steps.hardClue: Use the three items to open the path into the woods.
steps.clue: Use the three Tuning Forks to open the Forest.

steps.hardClue: Reveal three ritual paths and prepare the required ammunition and Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Reveal the Telescope, Effigy and Knight rituals, then prepare Silver Bullets and Alistair’s Annihilator.

steps.hardClue: Complete the three ritual questlines and collect their stone slabs.
steps.clue: Complete the Telescope, Effigy and Knight questlines and collect their three stone slabs.

steps.hardClue: Open the stone slab door in the woods and enter.
steps.clue: Open the stone slab door in the Forest and enter the boss arena.

steps.hardClue: Align the statue beams with the glowing square to trap and damage the boss.
steps.clue: Align the statue beams with the green square to trap and damage the Shadow Werewolf.

steps.hardClue: Locate the hidden square and realign the beams to defeat the boss.
steps.clue: Reveal the hidden green square and realign the statue beams to defeat the Shadow Werewolf.
